_comment: Handgepflegt (Issue #99): Englischer 'Was ist neu'-Text für GENAU die Version im Feld 'version'. Der CHANGELOG ist nur deutsch und wird nicht maschinell übersetzt (Owner-Entscheidung) - 'title' und 'en' werden beim Release von Hand geschrieben, sinngemäß zum deutschen CHANGELOG-Abschnitt derselben Version. Der Generator (scripts/generate-whatsnew.mjs) übernimmt 'en' NUR, wenn 'version' hier exakt zur aktuellen APP_VERSION passt - sonst bleibt EN absichtlich leer, damit eine vergessene Übersetzung nicht lautlos durchrutscht (siehe web/scripts/check-whatsnew.mjs).
en:
No migration, no change to your data. The most visible part: after this update the app greets you once with a box telling you what changed — this one.

• New: after every update the app shows once what changed, taken straight from the changelog, with the version's risk level, in German or English depending on your language setting. Dismiss it and it stays gone; you can reopen it any time from the version number in Settings. A brand-new installation doesn't see it — for a fresh install everything is new anyway.
• Images are now really optimized. The web container was missing the image library and could not write its cache, so every picture was served unoptimized and re-processed on every request. Both are fixed: pictures come from the cache from the second request on, and the transferred size dropped from about 94 KB to about 26 KB in our measurement.
• Security: the image cache now has a hard size limit. Next.js never cleans this cache up on its own — no expiry, no size limit — and the image service is reachable without login, so anyone on the network could have filled the disk. On a shared server a full disk would have hit other services too. Two independent brakes now: the cache lives in a memory area capped at 256 MB (the disk is no longer touched at all), and the same image can no longer be stored over and over via appended query parameters.
• Maintenance: database and frontend libraries refreshed (SQLAlchemy 2.0.52, TypeScript 5.9, Tailwind 3.4.19 and five more). Nothing changes for you — the money calculations were verified to return byte-for-byte the same results.
title: What's-new box, real image optimization
